Process: Baker's yeast (Saccharomyces cerevisiae) grown in a fed-batch bioreactor. Biomass concentration x1 and substrate (glucose) concentration x2 are measured every hour, in g/L. The operator sets the dilution rate u1 (1/h) and the substrate concentration in the feed u2 (g/L), both held constant between switches. Three experiments of 20 h with different starting biomass and input profiles. Measurement error is about 5% of the reading plus 0.01 g/L. The growth kinetics are unknown: find the rate law that explains the data.

Fitted candidates (all on the same data, 126 readings):

Candidate C8 (asprey_2000_contois_kinetics eq 18, rate law r = theta1*x2/(theta2*x1 + x2)):
asprey_2000_monod_kinetics + asprey_2000_contois_kinetics eq 18: chi2 1016.5 vs limit 148.8 (p = 0.000) (LACK OF FIT); AIC 1024.5; probability 0.000
   theta1   0.3591  95% CI [0.3493, 0.3688]  t 36.74
   theta2   0.01787  95% CI [0.01689, 0.01886]  t 18.16
   theta3   0.5992  95% CI [0.5804, 0.618]  t 31.90
   theta4   0.08383  95% CI [0.07662, 0.09103]  t 11.63
   ! theta1 and theta4 correlated (0.951): this data separates them only poorly (a caveat; their t-values above say whether each is still estimated precisely)
   misfit mostly in: E3:x2 (chi2 427 over 21 readings, model under-predicts on average, worst at t=20 h); E2:x2 (chi2 285 over 21 readings, model under-predicts on average, worst at t=5 h); E1:x2 (chi2 164 over 21 readings, model over-predicts on average, worst at t=6 h)

Candidate C40 (zentou_2019_andrews eq 5, rate law r = mumax*x2/(KS + x2 + x2**2/Ki)):

Round 1 of 3. Decide. If you accept, 'chosen' is the candidate label, e.g. C8.

answer.feedback: C40 fits within the noise and all five parameters are estimated precisely (t-values above 1). Its Akaike weight is 1.000 among these candidates. KS and Ki are strongly correlated (-0.96), so a more informative experiment could help separate them; this is a caveat, not grounds to reject the model. The other candidates show substantial glucose misfit, especially under-prediction in E3 and E2.
answer.reasoning: C40 is the only candidate with chi2 below the 95% limit, and each parameter has t > 1. The strong KS–Ki correlation does not violate the acceptance criteria because both parameters are individually estimated precisely.
